notes: The project ships no license file (all rights reserved by default); 'Unknown' is used because no SPDX identifier exists to declare.

Kopi stores its settings in %USERPROFILE%\.kopi\kopi.jsonc (downloaded language servers and icon themes included) and app state in %APPDATA%\Kopi; both live outside the Scoop directory and survive updates.
The app checks for updates once a day and can update itself in place from GitHub releases; this may conflict with Scoop-managed updates.
Java 21 or later is required only for the Java language server (jdtls), which Kopi downloads automatically; other languages work without Java.
